decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program has accumulated sunk operational costs and public launch commitments, and management persists to justify the earlier decision.

Although its public profile is lower than more visible products, the seventy-two-hour express program still carries significant operational commitments that weigh toward persistence, though its lower visibility keeps some withdrawal risk.

Strong public commitment from the homepage launch and European approval, together with high development and certification costs, make withdrawal very unlikely from an escalation-of-commitment perspective.
The express delivery product line has a dedicated website presence and multiple models, representing substantial sunk investment and public commitment that favor continued persistence.
The online ordering and digital services platform is central to the firm's announced direction toward deeper service support, with high visibility and sunk costs that make dropping unlikely.
